intro: The active participles of the present describe the person who performs an action: читающий студент, работающие люди.

bloques.titulo: The active participles of the present describe the person who performs an action: читающий студент, работающие люди.
texto: The active participles of the present describe the person who performs an action: читающий студент, работающие люди.
They are frequent in written texts; in daily speaking a subordinate with который is often preferred.

frases.ru: Студенты, изучающие русский, читают этот журнал.
frases.es: Los estudiantes que estudian ruso leen esta revista.
frases.en: Students who study Russian read this magazine.

frases.ru: Мы поговорили с преподавателем, ведущим курс.
frases.es: Hablamos con el profesor que imparte el curso.
frases.en: We talked to the teacher who taught the course.

opciones.explicacion: Работающие is an active participle present of работать.
This form does not express the relationship that the question calls for.
Check which word rules the case or the structure.

bloques.frase: Студенты, изучающие русский, читают этот журнал.

opciones.texto: Students who study Russian read this magazine.
opciones.explicacion: It corresponds to the first example.

opciones.texto: We talked to the teacher who taught the course.
opciones.explicacion: That's the translation of the second example.

bloques.frase: Мы поговорили с преподавателем, ведущим курс
bloques.traduccion: We talked to the teacher who taught the course.
bloques.explicacion: Look at the order of words and the outstanding grammatical form.
